tagline: Sibling of Vega 1 — second Soviet Venus + Halley double mission, lander + balloon then Halley flyby
description: Identical twin of Vega 1, launched 1984-12-21 (6 days after Vega 1). 4920 kg flyby bus + ~1500 kg descent module with second Venera-style lander + helium aerostat. Venus arrival 1985-06-15: lander touched down at 8.5°S, 164.5°E (Aphrodite Terra), returned 57 minutes of surface science; balloon floated in the cloud deck for 46 hours alongside Vega 1's. The flyby bus continued and encountered comet 1P/Halley 1986-03-09 at 8030 km — the second Halley encounter of the armada, 3 days after Vega 1 and 5 days before Giotto. Vega 1 + Vega 2 tracking refined the Halley nucleus position to within 50 km for Giotto's much closer approach.
best_known_for: Sibling of Vega 1 — second Soviet Venus + Halley double mission, 1986-03-09 Halley flyby
